name: await settled promise drains queued thenable and microtasks in order
source: async function main(): Promise<void> { const events: string[] = []; const thenable: any = { then(resolve: any): void { events.push('then'); resolve(1); } }; Promise.resolve(thenable); Promise.resolve().then(() => { events.push('micro'); }); events.push('sync'); await Promise.resolve(); events.push('after'); console.log(events.join(',')); }
